decision.explanation: Both awards are explicitly stated in the provided sources. Document D1S3 and related text (D1S4–D1S20) describe Knut Korsæth receiving the Commander of the Order of St. Olav, a Norwegian honor. Document D2S2 and related text (D2S3–D2S17) describe him receiving the Commander of the Legion of Honour, a French award. These are distinct awards from separate national honors systems and are not contradictory but complementary.
